name: Raw FM
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' three FM models on one axis: self-feedback, plain two-operator FM, and chaotic frequency feedback. The ancestor of Two-op FM, sharing its ratio quantizer and feedback axis, run raw: unfiltered feedback, no oversampling.

controls.label: Ratio
controls.description: Steps the modulator ratio through the tuned intervals. The modulator saturates once note plus ratio hits 116.

controls.label: Index
controls.description: Raises the modulation index linearly to a full cycle. Below noon pitch tames it, -1.5625% per semitone over 72.

controls.label: Character
controls.description: Moves from self-feedback through plain FM into chaotic wavetable feedback, which drops the modulator an octave.

controls.label: Depth
controls.description: Sets how deeply the feedback path drives itself around the stock amount.

outputs.aux: Modulator. The stereo toggle does not change this fixed carrier/modulator pair.

trigger: Realigns the carrier and modulator phases and clears the feedback memory.
upstream: Braids RenderFm, RenderFeedbackFm and RenderChaoticFeedbackFm (FM, FBFM, WTFM)
